locations.label: United States

locations.trend_insight: Remote and hybrid patterns remain strong for staff-level engineering and product roles.
locations.local_recommendation: Publish salary and location eligibility rules with state-level clarity to improve candidate fit.

locations.label: Canada

glossary_terms.label: Canonical URL
glossary_terms.beginner_explanation: A canonical URL tells search engines which page version should be treated as the primary source.
glossary_terms.technical_depth: In large pSEO systems, canonicalization consolidates ranking signals across overlapping combinations and prevents duplicate clusters.

glossary_terms.label: Keyword Cannibalization
glossary_terms.beginner_explanation: Keyword cannibalization happens when multiple pages compete for the same search intent.
glossary_terms.technical_depth: Prevention requires intent fingerprinting, strict primary-keyword ownership, and one canonical URL per intent.

glossary_terms.label: Hreflang
glossary_terms.beginner_explanation: Hreflang signals the language and regional version of a page for search engines.
glossary_terms.technical_depth: Reliable hreflang implementation requires reciprocal mapping across canonical, localized, and x-default pages.
